We need to propose retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We must use templates ['1914393','1914394','1914395'] in this order. So three steps, each using those template IDs sequentially.

We need to construct a JSON tree: root is molecule (target). Then child reaction using template 1914393, whose children are precursor molecules (type mol). Then each precursor may be further broken down using next template etc. Since we need at least 3 reactions, we will have three levels.

We need to know what each template does. We can retrieve template info.
